name: Ladder: SelfIdentification
summary: PlayerManagerSelfIdentificationMsg, wire 0x65c. The wire type was measured on build 30fe6461 through the client's own registration hook, and the 12,706-byte body was measured by two independent methods that agree cell for cell: a 135-byte prefix, a 56x56 big-endian u32 grid, and a 27-byte tail. The rung it was once believed to drive is a Carrier state flag, not this message.
purpose: Tell the player manager to spawn the player. The handler validates the game and client-SDK pointers, copies the message into the player-manager component, marks the client identified, and either spawns from the debug cvars or delegates the real spawn to FUN_14167cc70.

created_when: client has finished greetings and is waiting for its own identity
lifecycle.if_absent: client stays in WaitingForActorGameConnection and no player is spawned

envelope: Record envelope (owned by javelin/frame.py, not a body field): typed header 00 01 followed by the prefix varint 9c 19 = 1628 = 0x65c. Body fields below use RECORD offsets, so the first body byte is at 0x04.

fields.name: prefix_lead
fields.note: Measured 05. The same 05 also precedes the tail GUID, so it plausibly introduces an identity slot. meanings.md '0x65c body: measured'.

fields.name: identity_guid_prefix
fields.note: GUID #1, redacted in the committed dump (zeros). Filled by AZOTH_REPLAY_SELFIDENT_GUID at target (0x06, 0x065C, 0x05, 16). meanings.md '0x65c body: measured'.

fields.name: vtable_tag
fields.note: Measured 0x14786158 (bytes 58 61 78 14), a VA into the image's .rdata. The same tag appears in 0x40a and 0x1be. meanings.md '0x65c body: measured'.

fields.name: prefix_data
fields.note: Measured data, unnamed; ends in a run of zeros from 0x5d. Size stated, so carried as bytes(107); the meaning stays unnamed. meanings.md '0x65c body: measured'.

fields.name: grid_side
fields.note: Measured 0x38 = 56, the grid side. meanings.md '0x65c body: measured'.

fields.name: grid_cells
fields.note: The grid: 56 x 56 big-endian u32 cells = 12,544 bytes. The wire carries no row/column count prefix, so the fixed run is carried as bytes(12544); a cell is a small enum with 7 states plus an empty sentinel 0xFFFFFFFF. meanings.md '0x65c body: measured'.

fields.name: tail_zeros
fields.note: Measured ten zero bytes. meanings.md '0x65c body: measured'.

fields.name: tail_lead
fields.note: Measured 05, matching prefix_lead. meanings.md '0x65c body: measured'.

fields.name: identity_guid_tail
fields.note: GUID #2, redacted in the committed dump (zeros), the last 16 bytes of the record. Filled by nothing today. meanings.md '0x65c body: measured'.
